title: Six
desc: When a series of brutal murders shakes a small village, an investigator delves into the mystery, uncovering hidden truths that threaten to unravel the very fabric of the community.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: When an anchor, Arun, who is down on his luck, blames God for his misfortunes, God decides to give him his powers for ten days. Soon chaos ensues when Arun decides to grant everyone's wishes.

title: Roadside Rowdy
desc: A rich businessman's mother enters into a comatose state after an accident and the doctors are unable to cure her. However, a priest promises him that she would recover if he leads a beggar's life.

title: Return of Chandramukhi
desc: A man sets out to investigate the death of his brother at a haunted house, leading him to come across several supernatural experiences.

title: Snake
desc: A young farm girl, ensnared by a sinister stranger's lies, must wield the truth to rescue her family from impending danger.

title: Vedha
desc: A father and daughter embark on a killing spree in a bid to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. However, a police officer seeks to put an end to their murders.
